description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs an audio-based conversational pipeline using various services such as speech-to-text, language models, text-to-speech, and transport mechanisms for WebRTC calls. It includes configuration, event handling, and the orchestration of components for a speech-enabled chatbot system.

classes.name: TavusTransport
classes.description: A transport class for handling communication with Tavus API, configured for speech interactions.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the conversation context for the language model, maintaining message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Encapsulates the pair of aggregators for user and assistant responses in the conversation.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline that connects various speech and language processing components.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a specific task with its configuration, including the pipeline and parameters.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline task, such as sample rates and metrics flags.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executes the defined pipeline, managing its lifecycle and event processing.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes services, sets up the pipeline, and manages event handlers for a voice interaction session.
